tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations show a narrow s_grad range, so the siphon parameters remain confounded. Acquire the available open-branch discriminating probe to add wider s_grad leverage before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the standard siphon model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span (0.018) leaves vmax and rho poorly identifiable, risking an incorrect extrapolation.
It costs more and does not target the identified s_grad-collinearity ambiguity as directly.
It is irrelevant to the stated identifiability issue.
